name: SS Bunting
description: Strings of pastel pennants across the street between the facades, with warm paper lanterns, swaying in an analytic gusty breeze

interface.name: Seed
interface.description: Random seed for layout, colours and wind

interface.name: Verge Width
interface.description: Grass verge between curb and facade (strings anchor at the facade line)

interface.name: String Spacing
interface.description: Mean distance between strings along the street (jittered +-25 %)

interface.name: String Sag
interface.description: How far the rope drops at mid-street

interface.name: String Skew
interface.description: Largest diagonal slope of a string (along-street shift per unit across)

interface.name: Flag Spacing
interface.description: Distance between pennants along the rope

interface.name: Missing Flag Chance
interface.description: Chance that a pennant is missing from the rope

interface.name: Paper Lantern Chance
interface.description: Chance of a lantern in each of the two lantern slots of a string

interface.name: Paper Lantern Size
interface.description: Lantern paper height (its centre hangs 0.62x that below the rope)

interface.name: Paper Lantern Glow
interface.description: Colour of the light inside the paper

interface.name: Wind Strength
interface.description: Wind strength. 1 = the reference's light breeze (lanterns < 1 deg, flags ~3 deg); 4-6 = a clearly windy day

interface.name: Wind Gust
interface.description: How much the wind comes and goes (slow noise of time, travelling down the street)

interface.name: Wind Direction
interface.description: Wind heading relative to the street: 0 = blowing along it (+s), 90 deg = across

name: SS Facades
description: Continuous rows of half-timbered storybook houses along both sides of the path curve: jettied storeys on corbels, plaster in a pastel palette, timber frames, deep windows with shutters, doors and shopfronts, clay or slate roofs. Outputs the houses and the Anchors point cloud for SS Props

interface.name: Anchors
interface.description: Facade anchor points: anchor (1-7), ss_rot, ss_width, ss_house, ss_rand (see AGENTS.md)

interface.name: Seed
interface.description: Changes every random choice of the houses

interface.name: Curb Height
interface.description: Curb height (door thresholds sit on the verge at 0.55 of it)

interface.name: Verge Width
interface.description: Paving and grass between the curb and the house fronts

interface.name: Storeys Max
interface.description: Most storeys (incl. ground); the middle count is the most common

interface.name: Jetty Depth
interface.description: How far each upper storey overhangs the one below

interface.name: Stagger
interface.description: Each facade steps in or out of the facade line by up to this much

interface.name: Timber Density
interface.description: Share of houses with half-timber frames (the rest are plain plaster)

interface.name: Brace Mix
interface.description: Share of timbered houses that get braces or crosses rather than plain posts and rails

interface.name: Timber Color
interface.description: Colour of beams, joist ends and corbels

interface.name: Beam Width
interface.description: Thickness of the jetty beams and corbels

interface.name: Window Density
interface.description: Upper-floor windows per H of house width (rounded, 1-4 per storey)

interface.name: Shop Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a shopfront on the ground floor

interface.name: Arch Chance
interface.description: Share of doors with a round arch

interface.name: Pitch
interface.description: Roof slope; storybook roofs are steep

interface.name: Overhang
interface.description: How far the eaves (and gable verges) reach past the walls

interface.name: Gable Mix
interface.description: Share of houses with a gable to the street (else eaves to the street)

interface.name: Slate Mix
interface.description: Share of roofs in blue slate (else clay tile)

interface.name: Tower Chance
interface.description: Share of houses built two storeys taller with a steep blue slate spire roof

interface.name: Chimney Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a chimney

name: SS House Boxes
description: One shaped piece per point: a chamfered box, a roof prism, a cylinder or an arch ring, at Center with Size and Rotation (house-local). Boxes get a small chamfer of fixed size on every edge (the toy-like bevel). Writes ss_color, ss_size, ss_rand; the unit shape carries ss_unit

interface.name: Points
interface.description: One point per piece; house attributes ride along

interface.name: Size
interface.description: Piece size along its local axes

interface.name: Rotation
interface.description: Piece rotation in the house frame

interface.name: Shape
interface.description: 0 box, 1 prism (ridge along X on top), 2 cylinder along Y, 3 half arch ring in XZ, 4 arched opening (Center at the springing line, Size = width, depth, straight height)

name: SS House Plan
description: Every random decision per house, written as h_* attributes: storeys and floor heights, plaster colour, timber pattern, window columns and sizes, shutters, door (side, width, arch, colour), shop or ground windows, roof form, roof material and chimney

interface.name: Houses
interface.description: House points from SS Facades Parcels

interface.name: Curb Height
interface.description: Curb height; the verge (door thresholds) sits at 0.55 of it, as in SS Road

interface.name: Storeys Max
interface.description: Most storeys (incl. ground); the middle count is the most common

interface.name: Jetty Depth
interface.description: How far each upper storey overhangs the one below

interface.name: Timber Density
interface.description: Share of houses with half-timber frames (the rest are plain plaster)

interface.name: Brace Mix
interface.description: Share of timbered houses that get braces or crosses rather than plain posts and rails

interface.name: Window Density
interface.description: Upper-floor windows per H of house width (rounded, 1-4 per storey)

interface.name: Shop Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a shopfront on the ground floor

interface.name: Arch Chance
interface.description: Share of doors with a round arch

interface.name: Gable Mix
interface.description: Share of houses with a gable to the street (else eaves to the street)

interface.name: Slate Mix
interface.description: Share of roofs in blue slate (else clay tile)

interface.name: Tower Chance
interface.description: Share of houses built two storeys taller with a steep blue slate spire roof

interface.name: Chimney Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a chimney

name: SS Props
description: Window boxes, awnings, hanging signs, wall lanterns, ivy, and pots and barrels on the verge, placed on the facades' Anchors. Signs swing and lanterns flicker with Time

interface.name: Anchors
interface.description: Facade anchor points (SS Facades.Anchors): 'anchor' type, ss_rot, ss_width, ss_house, ss_rand

interface.name: Curve
interface.description: Street path curve (unused: props follow the anchors, which already follow the curve; kept for the shared group contract)

interface.name: Seed
interface.description: Random seed for which anchors get a prop and how it varies

interface.name: Time
interface.description: Seconds; drives sign swing and lantern flicker

interface.name: Window Box Chance
interface.description: Share of window sills that get a flower box

interface.name: Upper Floor Share
interface.description: Upper-floor sills get a box at Chance times this

interface.name: Box Flower Density
interface.description: How many blossoms per box (1 = like the reference)

interface.name: Flower Red
interface.description: Main geranium colour (about half the blossoms)

interface.name: Leaf Color
interface.description: Leaf colour of window boxes and leafy pots

interface.name: Awning Chance
interface.description: Share of shopfronts that get an awning

interface.name: Stripe Blue
interface.description: Cool awnings (green-grey and cream in the reference, about half)

interface.name: Stripe Pink
interface.description: Warm awnings (peach and cream in the reference, about 40%)

interface.name: Awning Depth
interface.description: How far awnings reach out over the verge

interface.name: Stripe Width
interface.description: One coloured plus one cream stripe (and one scallop)

interface.name: Sign Chance
interface.description: Share of bracket spots that get a hanging sign

interface.name: Round Share
interface.description: Share of round boards (the rest are bread boards)

interface.name: Wall Lantern Chance
interface.description: Share of lantern spots that get a lantern

interface.name: Flicker
interface.description: How much the glow flickers (0 = steady)

interface.name: Pot Chance
interface.description: Chance that a verge slot holds a pot

interface.name: Barrel Chance
interface.description: Chance that a verge spot starts with a pair of barrels

interface.name: Cluster Size
interface.description: Slots per verge spot (pots and barrels stand side by side)

interface.name: Ivy Chance
interface.description: Share of doors framed by ivy

interface.name: Ivy Spread
interface.description: How far ivy reaches from the door frame

interface.name: Swing Period
interface.description: Seconds per swing (2.5 divides the 20 s loop)

name: SS Road
description: The street surface along the path: a cobbled carriageway, grassy gutters, curbs of long stone blocks, a cobbled paving strip and a grass verge with tufts and small white flowers up to the house fronts

interface.name: Seed
interface.description: Changes every stone, block and tuft

interface.name: Curb Height
interface.description: Height of the curb above the road

interface.name: Verge Width
interface.description: Paved strip and grass between the curb and the house fronts

interface.name: Stone Size
interface.description: Typical cobble width across the street. Smaller stones = more instances

interface.name: Elongation
interface.description: Cobble width across the street divided by its length along it

interface.name: Jitter
interface.description: How loosely cobbles sit in their courses

interface.name: Dome Height
interface.description: Height of a cobble's crown above the mortar

interface.name: Detail
interface.description: Mesh vertices across each cobble (the main mesh budget)

interface.name: Block Variation
interface.description: How unevenly curb stones are set and tinted

interface.name: Gutter Width
interface.description: Grass strip on the road side of each curb

interface.name: Paving Width
interface.description: Cobbled strip behind each curb; the rest of the verge is grass

interface.name: Grass Density
interface.description: Grass tufts per square unit on the gutters and verges

interface.name: Flower Density
interface.description: Small white flowers per square unit in the grass

interface.name: Weed Density
interface.description: Small tufts per square unit growing between the road cobbles

interface.name: Mortar Color
interface.description: Mortar and dirt between the cobbles

name: SS Walker
description: The hooded storybook walker, seen from behind, walking along the path curve at s = Walk Start + Walk Speed * Time with planted feet, body bob and sway, arm swing and springy ear flaps, scarf and satchel

interface.name: Walk Start
interface.description: Arc length along the path at Time 0

interface.name: Walk Speed
interface.description: Walking speed in H (walker heights) per second

interface.name: Walk Offset
interface.description: Lateral offset d from the street centre line (+ left)

interface.name: Stride
interface.description: Distance walked per gait cycle (two steps); cadence = 2 * speed / stride

interface.name: Bob
interface.description: Body bob amplitude (twice per gait cycle)

interface.name: Ground Lift
interface.description: Height of the boot soles above the path curve (sits them on the cobble crowns)

interface.name: Flap Swing
interface.description: Ear flap bounce angle (before the spring's resonance gain)

interface.name: Flap Lag
interface.description: Ear flap spring period in seconds: longer is floppier and lags further behind the bob

interface.name: Scarf Swing
interface.description: Scarf panel and satchel swing angle

interface.name: Hood Size
interface.description: Scale of the hood, flaps and horns about the neck

interface.name: Flap Length
interface.description: Ear flap length from root to tip

interface.name: Scale
interface.description: Overall size of the walker (1 = 1 H tall); stride and speed stay as set

name: Storybook Street
description: A storybook street generated along any path curve: cobbled road, half-timbered houses, props, bunting and a walker. Every part group can also be used on its own

interface.name: Geometry
interface.description: Ignored; the street is generated from Path

interface.name: Path
interface.description: The curve the street follows. Draw any curve and pick it here

interface.name: Seed
interface.description: Changes every random choice: house widths, colours, props, stones

interface.name: Street Width
interface.description: Curb-to-curb width of the cobbled road

interface.name: Extra Storeys
interface.description: Taller or lower houses: added to Storeys Min and Max

interface.name: Timber Amount
interface.description: 0 = plain plaster houses, 1 = the reference, more = busier framing

interface.name: Prop Amount
interface.description: Scales every prop chance: window boxes, awnings, signs, lanterns, pots, barrels, ivy

interface.name: Flower Amount
interface.description: Blossoms in window boxes and flowers in the grass

interface.name: Festivity
interface.description: More bunting strings and paper lanterns (hide them with Show Bunting)

interface.name: Wind
interface.description: 1 = the reference's light breeze; 4-6 = a windy day (bunting, signs)

interface.name: Walk Speed
interface.description: Walking speed in H (walker heights) per second

interface.name: Curb Height
interface.description: Height of the curb above the road

interface.name: Verge Width
interface.description: Paved strip and grass between the curb and the house fronts

interface.name: Time Scale
interface.description: Speed of all animation (walk, wind); 0 freezes the street

interface.name: Time Offset
interface.description: Seconds added to scene time, to choose a different moment

interface.name: Stone Size
interface.description: Typical cobble width across the street. Smaller stones = more instances

interface.name: Elongation
interface.description: Cobble width across the street divided by its length along it

interface.name: Jitter
interface.description: How loosely cobbles sit in their courses

interface.name: Dome Height
interface.description: Height of a cobble's crown above the mortar

interface.name: Detail
interface.description: Mesh vertices across each cobble (the main mesh budget)

interface.name: Block Variation
interface.description: How unevenly curb stones are set and tinted

interface.name: Gutter Width
interface.description: Grass strip on the road side of each curb

interface.name: Paving Width
interface.description: Cobbled strip behind each curb; the rest of the verge is grass

interface.name: Grass Density
interface.description: Grass tufts per square unit on the gutters and verges

interface.name: Flower Density
interface.description: Small white flowers per square unit in the grass

interface.name: Weed Density
interface.description: Small tufts per square unit growing between the road cobbles

interface.name: Mortar Color
interface.description: Mortar and dirt between the cobbles

interface.name: Storeys Max
interface.description: Most storeys (incl. ground); the middle count is the most common

interface.name: Jetty Depth
interface.description: How far each upper storey overhangs the one below

interface.name: Stagger
interface.description: Each facade steps in or out of the facade line by up to this much

interface.name: Timber Density
interface.description: Share of houses with half-timber frames (the rest are plain plaster)

interface.name: Brace Mix
interface.description: Share of timbered houses that get braces or crosses rather than plain posts and rails

interface.name: Timber Color
interface.description: Colour of beams, joist ends and corbels

interface.name: Beam Width
interface.description: Thickness of the jetty beams and corbels

interface.name: Window Density
interface.description: Upper-floor windows per H of house width (rounded, 1-4 per storey)

interface.name: Shop Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a shopfront on the ground floor

interface.name: Arch Chance
interface.description: Share of doors with a round arch

interface.name: Pitch
interface.description: Roof slope; storybook roofs are steep

interface.name: Overhang
interface.description: How far the eaves (and gable verges) reach past the walls

interface.name: Gable Mix
interface.description: Share of houses with a gable to the street (else eaves to the street)

interface.name: Slate Mix
interface.description: Share of roofs in blue slate (else clay tile)

interface.name: Tower Chance
interface.description: Share of houses built two storeys taller with a steep blue slate spire roof

interface.name: Chimney Chance
interface.description: Share of houses with a chimney

interface.name: Window Box Chance
interface.description: Share of window sills that get a flower box

interface.name: Upper Floor Share
interface.description: Upper-floor sills get a box at Chance times this

interface.name: Box Flower Density
interface.description: How many blossoms per box (1 = like the reference)

interface.name: Flower Red
interface.description: Main geranium colour (about half the blossoms)

interface.name: Leaf Color
interface.description: Leaf colour of window boxes and leafy pots

interface.name: Awning Chance
interface.description: Share of shopfronts that get an awning

interface.name: Stripe Blue
interface.description: Cool awnings (green-grey and cream in the reference, about half)

interface.name: Stripe Pink
interface.description: Warm awnings (peach and cream in the reference, about 40%)

interface.name: Awning Depth
interface.description: How far awnings reach out over the verge

interface.name: Stripe Width
interface.description: One coloured plus one cream stripe (and one scallop)

interface.name: Sign Chance
interface.description: Share of bracket spots that get a hanging sign

interface.name: Round Share
interface.description: Share of round boards (the rest are bread boards)

interface.name: Wall Lantern Chance
interface.description: Share of lantern spots that get a lantern

interface.name: Flicker
interface.description: How much the glow flickers (0 = steady)

interface.name: Pot Chance
interface.description: Chance that a verge slot holds a pot

interface.name: Barrel Chance
interface.description: Chance that a verge spot starts with a pair of barrels

interface.name: Cluster Size
interface.description: Slots per verge spot (pots and barrels stand side by side)

interface.name: Ivy Chance
interface.description: Share of doors framed by ivy

interface.name: Ivy Spread
interface.description: How far ivy reaches from the door frame

interface.name: Swing Period
interface.description: Seconds per swing (2.5 divides the 20 s loop)

interface.name: String Spacing
interface.description: Mean distance between strings along the street (jittered +-25 %)

interface.name: String Sag
interface.description: How far the rope drops at mid-street

interface.name: String Skew
interface.description: Largest diagonal slope of a string (along-street shift per unit across)

interface.name: Flag Spacing
interface.description: Distance between pennants along the rope

interface.name: Missing Flag Chance
interface.description: Chance that a pennant is missing from the rope

interface.name: Paper Lantern Chance
interface.description: Chance of a lantern in each of the two lantern slots of a string

interface.name: Paper Lantern Size
interface.description: Lantern paper height (its centre hangs 0.62x that below the rope)

interface.name: Paper Lantern Glow
interface.description: Colour of the light inside the paper

interface.name: Wind Strength
interface.description: Wind strength. 1 = the reference's light breeze (lanterns < 1 deg, flags ~3 deg); 4-6 = a clearly windy day

interface.name: Wind Gust
interface.description: How much the wind comes and goes (slow noise of time, travelling down the street)

interface.name: Wind Direction
interface.description: Wind heading relative to the street: 0 = blowing along it (+s), 90 deg = across

interface.name: Walk Start
interface.description: Arc length along the path at Time 0

interface.name: Walk Offset
interface.description: Lateral offset d from the street centre line (+ left)

interface.name: Stride
interface.description: Distance walked per gait cycle (two steps); cadence = 2 * speed / stride

interface.name: Bob
interface.description: Body bob amplitude (twice per gait cycle)

interface.name: Ground Lift
interface.description: Height of the boot soles above the path curve (sits them on the cobble crowns)

interface.name: Flap Swing
interface.description: Ear flap bounce angle (before the spring's resonance gain)

interface.name: Flap Lag
interface.description: Ear flap spring period in seconds: longer is floppier and lags further behind the bob

interface.name: Scarf Swing
interface.description: Scarf panel and satchel swing angle

interface.name: Hood Size
interface.description: Scale of the hood, flaps and horns about the neck

interface.name: Flap Length
interface.description: Ear flap length from root to tip

interface.name: Scale
interface.description: Overall size of the walker (1 = 1 H tall); stride and speed stay as set
